remaining_risks: Person/Org recall relies on rules + structure labels + user dictionary until a qualified offline NER is added; every affected document is REVIEW_REQUIRED unless dictionary-confirmed.
waves.notes: Deterministic CN rules with checksum validation (ID18/GB32100 USCC/Luhn) and per-rule positives/negatives; money/date classification-only; structure label recognizer; project dictionary (blacklist/whitelist/alias groups); registry with deterministic overlap resolution (longest, severity, rule id); optional Presidio adapter behind an extra; recognizer.yaml single rule source; model manifest with honest unqualified NER/OCR state.

Honesty rule: without qualified NER, AUTO_READY requires a user dictionary covering subjects; otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED.

remaining_risks: Face/stamp/signature detection remains manual-box-only by design; no generative repair.
zxing-cpp is optional; if absent, QR signals are skipped and scan review still applies.
waves.notes: Scan pipeline: hash-locked RapidOCR models (verified on every init, mismatch => CLOSED_BLOCK), reading order, OCR confidence < 0.85 => OCR_LOW_CONFIDENCE, non-empty page with empty OCR => MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, whole scan always REVIEW_REQUIRED regardless of confidence; OCR box -> pixel redaction with alias draw; manual boxes from decisions; QR/barcode via zxing-cpp: decoded text enters identifiers, undecodable => QR_UNREADABLE, codes physically removed; OCR raw text confined to private state; per-page states recorded (PENDING..BLOCKED).
